name: OPEC
officialName: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries
aliases: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries

flag.description: A light blue field with the white OPEC logo in the centre: the lower-case letters o, p, e and c set in a square around a long, tapering vertical stroke.
flag.symbolism: The logo is built from the organisation's own initials, OPEC.

hook: OPEC spells out its own name in fat white letters on sky blue, o and p over e and c, threaded on one tall stroke.
trivia: OPEC was founded in Baghdad in September 1960 by Iran, Iraq, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia and Venezuela, and moved its headquarters from Geneva to Vienna in 1965.
The United Arab Emirates left OPEC on 1 May 2026, after Angola had left in January 2024.
